instagram.author: juliekstevens_
instagram.body:
You have power!  So much more than you realize…. Which is why I inspired the app @vedalifeinc to help. It helps you understand what you can do to give yourself even more strength and power to fight back against disease!  #healsmarter #datagangster #beadatag #vedalife
I know it's hard being in limbo when you have a positive CTDNA and you can't pharmaceutically treat it. But guys, this is where you have power. It's where you have power to eat broccoli or kiwi or make sure you're getting your right berries because the foods we eat impact our natural health defense systems. This is the time when we have power to work out and walk and weight lift. It's the power we have to sauna. It's the power we have to sleep and make sure we're not letting uh crazy things get our cortisol and stressing out on things that don't matter. Guys, there's just a way to level up when you understand you're at risk, that gives you an advantage and so I just want to encourage you while it's a little bit scary to be in limbo. We got options, we got power. So, give your body everything it needs to thrive. May you live long and lucky.

tiktok.author: ednaokang
tiktok.body:
I swear by these apps!! 💕 #NurseLife #NPStudent #NursingSchool #ProductivityApps #NurseTok
I'm a 25 year old psychiatric nurse living in New York City, and I also just got accepted into psychiatric NP school. This week was my first week of NP school and I'm gonna tell you guys the apps that I use to be successful and get ready for my first exam. Number one, Google sheets. I'm gonna insert a picture here so that you guys can see this, but for this semester alone, I have chronologically ordered every single exam, class assignment, and anything that I need to have for my classes on this spreadsheet. This helps me stay organized for the semester so that I'm not missing any important assignments test class days because I get overwhelmed and I tend to forget things. So having everything organized like this on Google Sheets is such a lifesaver. Another tech app I used to be successful in MP school is Google Calendar. The reason I love Google Calendar is because you can integrate all your calendars. So I integrated my personal calendar with my school calendar, which allowed me to see the days that I needed to study, the days that I need to get things done, and just organize all the different parts of my life. Another app that I use is Nursing Grid. The reason I love Nursing Grid is because you could put your nursing work schedule right into the app and my co workers and my friends can also see the days that I work. But the Great thing about Nursing Grid is that you could actually add your nursing schedule from that app. It's a Google calendar, so literally all the different parts of my lives are organized on Google Calendar now. The final tech app I use to make me successful in MP school is good notes, and I've been saying this to people for years. I used good notes when I was in nursing school and now I'm using it for MP school and it's such a lifesaver. The reason I love Good Notes is because you can download all your Powerpoint slides onto the app and you can write notes right onto it. So for my exam, I'm pretty sure we had to go over like 10 lecture slides, and I downloaded all those lecture slides onto my Good Notes app and as I was hearing the professor speak, I was actively writing down notes on those Powerpoint slides. Let me know if you guys want a tutorial for that. those are the tech apps I use to make me successful as an NP student who's also a full time nurse influencer and owns two businesses in New York City. Love you and I mean it. Bye babes!

tiktok.author: cheryl.pierce
tiktok.body:
As a nurse, one of the biggest challenges I see is how confusing healthcare can be. Lab results, prescriptions, insurance coverage, medical bills… it can feel overwhelming. That’s why I was excited to discover August AI, a free health companion that helps you better understand your health information and prepare for conversations with your healthcare providers. It’s not a replacement for your doctor, but it can help you feel more informed, ask better questions, and make more confident health decisions. Knowledge is power, especially when it comes to your health. #AugustAI #HealthEducation #NurseLife #PatientAdvocate #HealthTech
What if you had a doctor friend in your pocket 24/7 I found this free app called August AI And honestly this is the kind of tool I wish more people knew about. You can use it to help understand confusing lab results, prescription instructions, insurance coverage, medical bills, or even symptoms you're not sure about. Now, it does not replace your doctor and it's not medical advice, but it can help you feel more informed before your appointment and ask better questions and stop spiralling on Google at 3:00am. As a nurse, I love tools that help people feel calmer, clearer, and more empowered about their health. Just search August A. I. In the App Store or Google Play. It's free and it's like having a health companion in your pocket.

Those $5 have been a life saver sometimes when all I have is lint in my wallet 😵‍💫🥹 #nursingstudent #futurenurse #nursingstudenttips
